Apply colour
Choose a shade or enter a hex colour. Applies to the tinted theme.
Use six hex digits, for example #326A56.
Audio mode help
Removes music while keeping speech and other sounds.
A good starting point for everyday listening.
Removes music and lets you choose how much background sound remains.
Use the Home slider: lower for a quieter background, higher for more ambience.
Focuses on speech by muting music and background sound.
Some sound effects may also disappear.
Start and stop
Choose a mode, then press the power button to start. Press it again to stop. Choosing a mode while stopped keeps Sukut off.
Lets your phone add supported Dolby and equaliser effects to the filtered sound.
Keep on for Bluetooth speakers, headphones and earbuds. With it off, Dolby and other phone effects may be bypassed. Enable the effects you want in your phone settings.
Can add audio delay. Off uses faster direct playback, which may skip phone effects.
Lowest — sound arrives sooner, but may stutter when the phone is busy.
Balanced — a short wait for smoother sound. Start here.
Maximum — a longer wait that can reduce pauses on busy phones. Sound arrives later.
Good to know
These options change playback, not music-removal strength. Changing either while playing briefly restarts audio.
